attributes.name: card statistic/rank presentation
attributes.definition: How numeric or ranking figures within cards are visually presented (bordered/divided vs. open columns vs. large accent numerals).

values.definition: Stats laid out as open columns with no borders or dividers.
Oversized, accent-coloured ordinal numbers lead each item.
Stats separated by borders, boxes or dividers.
No stats or rank figures in cards.

attributes.name: card imagery and rating decoration
attributes.definition: Whether cards include images, star ratings or similar decorative media.

values.definition: Cards contain no images or stars.
Cards include thumbnails, images or star ratings.
Page or statement does not address it.

attributes.name: card label and title typography
attributes.definition: Casing and weight treatment of labels and titles inside cards.

values.definition: Labels are written in Title Case.
Card titles are set in bold weight.
